scope: Retrospective differences of recorded monotonic probe timestamps; genuine SendInput/NVDA/driver/models, explicit recording-output test double; no device/acoustic latency acceptance.
interpretation: raw-to-typedEvent includes native Windows/NVDA helper and event dispatch, scheduling and the probe callbacks; it is not isolated model time.

pre_synthSpeak observer fires immediately before actual getSynth().speak in official SpeechManager._pushNextSpeech; recorded interval also includes later hook callbacks and own planner/feed observers. Probe overhead is not calibrated or subtracted.

First RU shared letter delay is predominantly typed-event-to-pre-synthSpeak (54.5959ms), while subsequent driver-to-first-PCM is4.3203ms. Existing timestamps cannot isolate character-data lazy load from speech processing/queue scheduling.

Delimiter rows have native typed-word echo enabled. English ! sends word ab before bang; Russian space sends word абы before пробел. The first PCM belongs to the word sequence; these169/74ms totals do not isolate symbol rendering.
Nine single observations do not establish a distribution or P95. Direct89-letter first-use maximum3.73ms is a separate driver-level test, not interchangeable with actual keyboard timing.

primary_source_references.finding: queueEvent schedules only gainFocus immediate; typedCharacter uses ordinary eventQueue.
PUMP_MAX_DELAY=10; CorePump requests delayed wx.Timer; not a promise that total OS/native dispatch is10ms.

recommendations: Repeat owned real-key character-only native echo with speakTypedWordsOFF and a separate normal ON run; preserve/restore native config, layout and protected-input checks.

Timestamp native pre_speechQueued and each pre_synthSpeak request separately, recording emitted IndexCommand.index without modifying commands; retain bounded planner/feed events so word-first and symbol-second portions can be distinguished honestly.
Repeat enough cases for latency distribution after prepared banks; keep cold locale first-use separate from resident cases. Do not change NVDA global timer/queue policy to improve a benchmark.

Add actual Backspace and LeftArrow outside typed-context with RU keyboard over UK document text, plus forced-language and disabled-RU UI cases; expected native settings/precedence and character deletion/navigation remain authoritative.
